newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks slip in early morning trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks slip in early morning trade.

text.p: Tokyo stocks slipped in early, Wednesday morning trade, unable to recover from glum sentiment created by anxieties over the widening Nomura Securities Co Ltd scandal, brokers said.
They said that the 225-share Nikkei benchmark may test the 20,000 barrier.
As of 0022 GMT, the Nikkei average was 60.61 points or 0.30 percent lower at 20,114.91. Its September futures were up 50 points at 20,150.
